payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D DP with states (position i, current digit j) counting valid prefixes, transitioning from j to c,d using (a[i+1]+j)//2 and (a[i+1]+j+1)//2.
payload.rationale: The solution explicitly uses a 2D list dp[i][j] over positions and digits 0-9, which matches dp_2d_state exactly. The recurrence involves only adjacent columns, typical of linear DP with state dimension 2.
